name: fub-clipper
description: Fub browser clipper (Chromium/Firefox/Safari): article/selection/highlights capture to capture-v1. Zero runtime dependencies; loads unpacked without a build step.

scripts.check: node --check src/capture.js && node --check src/convert.js && node --check src/templates.js && node --check src/matcher.js && node --check src/i18n.js && node --check src/images.js && node --check src/interpreter.js && node --check src/channel.js && node --check src/extract.js && node --check src/selectors.js && node --check src/background.js && node --check src/popup.js && node --check src/options.js && node --check tests/security-limits.test.mjs && node --check smoke-headless.mjs
scripts.package:chromium: zip -r fub-clipper-chromium.zip manifest.json src icons capture-v1.schema.json native-host
scripts.package:firefox: rm -rf dist-firefox && mkdir -p dist-firefox && cp -r src icons capture-v1.schema.json native-host dist-firefox/ && cp manifest.firefox.json dist-firefox/manifest.json && cd dist-firefox && zip -r ../fub-clipper-firefox.zip manifest.json src icons capture-v1.schema.json native-host
